prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a low-speed head-on collision. The patient had 29 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1500; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: The patient presented following a low-speed head-on collision with complaints of low back pain and muscle tightness across the lumbar region. The reported mechanism is consistent with the injury pattern observed on examination. Over the course of 29 visits, treatment proceeded along a typical conservative pathway, including manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and graded activity instruction. Frequency of visits decreased steadily as symptoms improved and function returned. Several objective findings, including localized paraspinal tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion, support the reported injury, while straight leg raise testing, neurological screening, and reflexes were within normal limits. No prior injury or treatment involving the lumbar spine is documented in the available history. Billing records reflect a single charge for each service rendered, with no duplicate or repeated entries. At discharge the patient reported near-complete resolution of symptoms and was released to full, unrestricted activity with a home exercise program.
